records.label: spacr.measure.measure_crop.job_callback#1
records.source: The 4-tuple ``(index, average_time, cells, figs)`` that :func:`_measure_crop_core` returns, taken straight off the ``AsyncResult`` -- one result, not the list that :func:`process_measure_crop_results` takes, which is why it is re-wrapped as ``[result]`` below. ``index`` is the position in ``files`` and is translated back through ``index_to_file`` so the ledger entry names the field rather than a number. ``cells`` decides the verdict: the success path leaves the ``np.unique(cell_mask)`` array there, while a plain int ``0`` is the cross-process failure sentinel a worker leaves when it caught its own exception, so only that int records a failure. ``figs`` may be an empty dict -- nothing is drawn unless ``settings['plot']``. Passing the same field twice is safe for the counters (``completed_jobs`` and ``reported_files`` are sets) but would save its figures twice, so the retry loop calls this only for the attempt that actually returned.
records.context: The 4-tuple ``(index, average_time, cells, figs)`` that :func:`_measure_crop_core` returns, taken straight off the ``AsyncResult`` -- one result, not the list that :func:`process_measure_crop_results` takes, which is why it is re-wrapped as ``[result]`` below. ``index`` is the position in ``files`` and is translated back through ``index_to_file`` so the ledger entry names the field rather than a number. ``cells`` decides the verdict: the success path leaves the ``np.unique(cell_mask)`` array there, while a plain int ``0`` is the cross-process failure sentinel a worker leaves when it caught its own exception, so only that int records a failure. ``figs`` may be an empty key-value mapping -- nothing is drawn unless ``settings['plot']``. Passing the same field twice is safe for the counters (``completed_jobs`` and ``reported_files`` are sets) but would save its figures twice, so the retry loop calls this only for the attempt that actually returned.
records.translation: 4-टपल ``(index, average_time, cells, figs)`` जो :func:`_measure_crop_core` लौटाता है, सीधे ``AsyncResult`` से लिया गया -- एक परिणाम, न कि वह सूची जो :func:`process_measure_crop_results` लेता है, इसीलिए नीचे इसे ``[result]`` के रूप में फिर से लपेटा जाता है। ``index`` ``files`` में स्थिति है और ``index_to_file`` के माध्यम से वापस बदला जाता है ताकि लेजर प्रविष्टि किसी संख्या के बजाय फ़ील्ड का नाम दे। ``cells`` निर्णय तय करता है: सफलता का मार्ग वहाँ ``np.unique(cell_mask)`` ऐरे छोड़ता है, जबकि सादा int ``0`` वह क्रॉस-प्रोसेस विफलता संकेतक है जो worker अपना अपवाद पकड़ने पर छोड़ता है, इसलिए केवल वही int विफलता दर्ज करता है। ``figs`` खाली dict हो सकता है -- ``settings['plot']`` के बिना कुछ नहीं बनता। एक ही फ़ील्ड दो बार देना काउंटरों के लिए सुरक्षित है (``completed_jobs`` और ``reported_files`` सेट हैं) पर उसके चित्र दो बार सहेजे जाते, इसलिए पुनः प्रयास लूप इसे केवल उसी प्रयास के लिए कॉल करता है जो वास्तव में लौटा।
